(d) On October 20, 2026, Daniel Brennan was appointed as a new member of the board of directors (the Board ) of Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated (the Company ). In connection with the appointment of Mr. Brennan, the size of the Board was increased from ten to eleven members. Mr. Brennan also has joined our Audit and Finance Committee. Mr. Brennan served as the Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer of Boston Scientific Corporation, a medical device and healthcare technology company, from January 2014 until his retirement in June 2025. He was the Senior Vice President, Corporate Controller from 2010 through 2013 and, prior to that role, he held various roles of increasing responsibility within the finance function from 1996 through 2009. Mr. Brennan has served on the board of directors of Waters Corporation, a publicly listed company focused on the development of analytical instruments and software, since November 2022, and he has served on the board of directors of Madrigal Pharmaceuticals, a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company, since August 2025. Mr. Brennan previously served on the board of directors of Nuance Corporation, a publicly traded communication company, until it was acquired by Microsoft Corporation in March 2022. He most recently served as Chief Executive Officer ( CEO ) of Sanofi S.A. from September 2019 through February 2026, where he led a sweeping transformation of the organization. Prior to Sanofi, Mr. Hudson served as CEO of Novartis Pharmaceuticals from 2016 to 2019 and as a member of the Novartis Executive Committee.
